pins.title: RENPHO vs Naipo vs Breo iNeck: Which Shiatsu Neck Massager Fits How You Use It?
pins.subtitle: Trying it out, wider coverage, or daily use
pins.description: Picking a shiatsu neck massager for desk tension comes down to how you'll use it. RENPHO covers the essentials with 8 kneading nodes, adjustable heat, and a car adapter. Naipo adds a back attachment for tightness that spreads lower. Breo iNeck is the premium option in our comparison. Not medical advice. #neckmassager #shiatsu #deskjob #neckpain #selfcare

pins.title: Neck Massager With a Back Attachment: When Desk Tightness Spreads Past Your Neck
pins.subtitle: Neck-only or neck plus lower back?
pins.description: Stiff neck after a desk day, but your lower back feels it too? Some shiatsu massagers are neck-and-shoulders only, while others come with an extended strap and a back attachment. If your tightness stays in your neck, a neck-only model saves drawer space. Hands-free, heated, and easy to use on the couch. Not medical advice. #shiatsumassager #backmassager #wfh #desksetup #relaxation

pins.title: Shiatsu Neck Massager Safety: Who Should Check With a Doctor First
pins.subtitle: Read this before you add heat and pressure
pins.description: Shiatsu neck massagers apply continuous kneading pressure and heat to the neck, so they aren't for everyone. Check with a doctor first if you have a herniated disc, a recent neck injury or surgery, a pacemaker or implanted device, are pregnant, or have reduced skin sensation in the neck. Pain that radiates down an arm is a reason to see a provider. Not medical advice. #neckmassager #shiatsu #neckpain #deskworker
